about_the_game:
"My dream is to be a film director."

About "Blue Hawaii Aniki's Soft Ore Demand DEBUT"

"Blue Hawaii Aniki's Soft Ore Demand DEBUT" is a short visual novel modeled after a late-night variety show.

"Blue Hawaii Aniki," who just sleeps in his bed, dreams of being a film director.

A self-proclaimed master director appears on a B-grade late-night variety show to earn a little extra cash.

"Blue Hawaii Aniki's Soft Ore Demand" is a B-grade late-night variety show.

With social satire, silly plot twists, and a nostalgic yet silly feel, this "TV-like" feel is fully realized in the form of a game.

This is the debut title in the upcoming Blue Hawaii Aniki series. It includes several segments and is expected to last approximately one hour.

This is a game recommended for those looking to relax and laugh.
